title: Document the secret SSM parameters as the person-only exception
description: /papyrus/the-hallucinator/openai-api-key and /papyrus/shared/typesafe-api-key are SecureString values. CloudFormation cannot create SecureString parameters and values never go in Git, so a person puts the values; the pipeline manages everything around them. Document in infra/README.md.
